vulnerabilities.name: Dos Unbounded Operation
vulnerabilities.short_message: In order to prevent a single transaction from consuming all the gas in a block, unbounded operations must be avoided
vulnerabilities.long_message: In order to prevent a single transaction from consuming all the gas in a block, unbounded operations must be avoided. This includes loops that do not have a bounded number of iterations, and recursive calls.

vulnerabilities.name: Dos Unexpected Revert With Storage
vulnerabilities.short_message: This storage (vector or map) operation is called without access control
vulnerabilities.long_message: It occurs by preventing transactions by other users from being successfully executed forcing the blockchain state to revert to its original state.

vulnerabilities.name: Unsafe Unwrap
vulnerabilities.long_message: This vulnerability class pertains to the inappropriate usage of the unwrap method in Rust, which is commonly employed for error handling. The unwrap method retrieves the inner value of an Option or Result, but if an error or None occurs, it triggers a panic and crashes the program.

vulnerabilities.name: Unused Return Enum
vulnerabilities.short_message: If any of the variants (Ok/Err) is not used, the code could be simplified or it could imply a bug
vulnerabilities.long_message: Soroban functions can return a Result enum with a custom error type. This is useful for the caller to know what went wrong when the message fails. The definition of the Result type enum consists of two variants: Ok and Err. If any of the variants is not used, the code could be simplified or it could imply a bug.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing New Admin Auth
vulnerabilities.short_message: New admin/owner address must sign before being stored
vulnerabilities.long_message: When updating admin or owner, the incoming address should also sign to prevent accidental bricking due to a mistaken address.

vulnerabilities.name: Unprotected Update Current Contract Wasm
vulnerabilities.short_message: This update_current_contract_wasm is called without access control
vulnerabilities.long_message: If users are allowed to call update_current_contract_wasm, they can intentionally modify the contract behaviour, leading to the loss of all associated data/tokens and functionalities given by this contract or by others that depend on it. To prevent this, the function should be restricted to administrators or authorized users only.

vulnerabilities.name: Unsafe Map Get
vulnerabilities.short_message: Unsafe access on Map, method could panic.
vulnerabilities.long_message: This vulnerability class pertains to the inappropriate usage of the get method for Map in soroban

vulnerabilities.name: Soroban Version
vulnerabilities.short_message: Use the latest version of Soroban
vulnerabilities.long_message: Using a older version of Soroban can be dangerous, as it may have bugs or security issues. Use the latest version available.

vulnerabilities.name: Avoid Vec Map Input
vulnerabilities.short_message: Avoid accepting soroban_sdk::Vec or Map parameters without validating their contents.
vulnerabilities.long_message: Soroban Vec and Map<K, V> parameters arrive as raw Val values. Validate or normalize every element before storing or reusing them so a bad conversion does not halt contract execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Storage Change Events
vulnerabilities.short_message: Consider emiting an event when storage is modified
vulnerabilities.long_message: Emiting an event when storage changes is a good practice to make the contracts more transparent and usable to its clients and observers

vulnerabilities.name: Integer Overflow Or Underflow
vulnerabilities.short_message: Potential for integer arithmetic overflow/underflow. Consider checked, wrapping or saturating arithmetic.
vulnerabilities.long_message: An overflow/underflow is typically caught and generates an error. When it is not caught, the operation will result in an inexact result which could lead to serious problems.

vulnerabilities.name: Divide Before Multiply
vulnerabilities.short_message: Division before multiplication might result in a loss of precision
vulnerabilities.long_message: Division before multiplication might result in a loss of precision

vulnerabilities.name: Dynamic Storage
vulnerabilities.short_message: Using dynamic types in instance or persistent storage can lead to unnecessary growth or storage-related vulnerabilities.
vulnerabilities.long_message: Using dynamic types in instance or persistent storage can lead to unnecessary growth or storage-related vulnerabilities.
